patterns.summary_ru: Паритет: процедурный цикл и функциональный trampoline для конечного неотрицательного n.

patterns.scenario_en: For nonnegative n, compute parity. An unfinished step returns more(partial(otherStep; (n−1))) without invoking the other step. trampoline invokes one retained thunk at a time until done.
patterns.expected_ru: 0 → true, 1 → false, 100001 → false; LMX возвращает 1, 0, 0. Каждый шаг возвращает управление драйверу; вложенная цепочка вызовов even/odd не накапливается.
patterns.expected_en: 0 yields true, 1 false and 100001 false; LMX returns 1, 0, 0. Every step returns control to the driver; no nested even/odd call chain accumulates.
patterns.lmx_notes_ru: Договор клиента — parity конечного неотрицательного n: 0→1, 1→0, 100001→0. Процедурный цикл хранит состояние; функциональный вариант показывает настоящий trampoline и два шага с общим телом. Полная общая реализация trampoline остаётся отдельно в092.

module ExecuteAroundExample where
import Control.Exception (Exception, bracket, throwIO, try)
import Data.IORef (newIORef, modifyIORef', readIORef)

newtype Resource = Resource Int
data ResourceFailure = ResourceFailure deriving Show
instance Exception ResourceFailure

run :: Int -> IO Int
run mode = do
  events <- newIORef 0
  let note n = modifyIORef' events (\x -> x * 10 + n)
      failure = throwIO ResourceFailure
      acquire = do
        note 1
        if mode == 2 then failure else pure (Resource 42)
      action (Resource value) = do
        note 2
        if mode == 1 then failure else pure value
      release _ = note 3
  result <- try (bracket acquire release action) :: IO (Either ResourceFailure Int)

import Control.Exception (Exception, bracket, throwIO, try)
import Data.IORef (newIORef, modifyIORef', readIORef)

newtype Resource = Resource Int
data ResourceFailure = ResourceFailure deriving Show

module Partial (Args(..), Callable(..), Append, appendArgs, partial) where
import Data.Kind (Type)

data Args (types :: [Type]) where
  Nil :: Args '[]
  (:&) :: value -> Args rest -> Args (value ': rest)
infixr 5 :&

type family Append prefix rest where
  Append '[] rest = rest
  Append (value ': prefix) rest = value ': Append prefix rest

appendArgs :: Args prefix -> Args rest -> Args (Append prefix rest)
appendArgs Nil rest = rest
appendArgs (value :& prefix) rest = value :& appendArgs prefix rest

newtype Callable inputs result = Callable { invoke :: Args inputs -> result }

partial :: Callable (Append prefix rest) result -> Args prefix -> Callable rest result
partial (Callable operation) prefix =
  Callable (\rest -> operation (appendArgs prefix rest))
